title: EIPOD-LinC Fellowship Programme
about: EMBL Interdisciplinary Postdocs - Exploring Life in Context (EIPOD-LinC). EMBL's 2026 call runs from November 25, 2026 to February 1, 2027; applicants need a PhD by the deadline. Interviews April 8-9, 2027; latest start 1 September 2027.
